t: The dining hall is next to the student center.
Hot meals are served until two thirty.
All vegetarian dishes are clearly labeled.
Please place your empty trays on the cart by the exit.
Students can pay with their ID cards or with the mobile app.
Weekly menus are posted online and on the notice board near the entrance.
If you have a food allergy, please speak with a staff member before you order so that we can prepare a safe meal for you.
